titulo: When a VLA drives the whole body
lead: A VLA sees the scene, understands the request, and proposes an action a few times per second. Turning that into safe movement of 29 joints, without falling, is the job of whole-body control. In this lesson you send high-level commands to the simulated G1 and see what it carries out and what it refuses before moving.
objetivo: send high-level commands to a simulated whole-body controller and see which ones it executes and which it refuses.

aprende.t: What the VLA hands down: targets, tokens or actions
Decoupled WBC: legs by RL, arms by IK
The lower layer checks before it executes
The end-to-end VLA flow on the G1 (GR00T N1.7 + SONIC)

hero_alt: Humanoid robot with a dark visor carefully placing a mug on a countertop, with a blurred monitor in the foreground.

nos.detalhe: It sees the camera, reads the request, and generates the action. In Helix 02, S1 emits joint targets at 200 Hz; in GR00T N1.7, S2 is a reasoning VLM and S1 is a diffusion model. How they work inside is the topic of the vla-v72 course.

What passes from top to bottom. In SONIC it is a single token space (64 dimensions) that accepts VR, human video, and VLA. In the kit it is a JSON with named actions (reach, rotate the torso, return).

itens.t: out of reach, out of limit

nos.detalhe: The bottom layer does not execute blindly: known action? joint within limit? target within arm's reach? Anything that doesn't pass is refused with the reason, and the robot stays as it was.
Decoupled as in GR00T-WholeBodyControl (used under GR00T N1.5/N1.6): legs by an RL policy, arms by IK. In the kit, the legs hold the model's pose by PD; this is where the policy would go.
The same motor PD from the earlier lessons, underneath S0. A command only counts as executed if the hand reached the target and the robot is still standing.

secoes.legenda: The VLA proposes; whole-body control checks and executes. Safety cannot depend only on the model above.

secoes.sub: Click each case. Facts with sources; VLA details in vla-v72.

texto: Three layers: slow S2, S1 emitting joint targets at 200 Hz, and a learned S0 at 1 kHz, which replaced 109,504 lines of C++ (01/27/2026).
S0 was trained with more than 1,000 h of retargeted human motion and sim-to-real RL: lessons 2 to 4 of this course at industrial scale.
On 05/07/2026 the GR00T-WholeBodyControl repository published the end-to-end VLA flow on the G1: collect data through teleoperation, fine-tune GR00T N1.7, and deploy with SONIC as whole-body control.
SONIC v1.1 (07/23/2026) was trained with wrist pose augmentation precisely for teleop and for VLAs that use this control.
Before SONIC, GR00T N1.5 and N1.6 ran on the decoupled WBC: RL on the legs, IK on the arms. This is the split the kit imitates.
Advantage: simple and predictable. Limit: the torso and legs don't help the arm reach farther.

secoes.sub: The commands file plays the role of a VLA's output. comando_wbc.py checks each one, executes it in 1 s (ramp + closed-loop correction at 50 Hz), and says whether the hand arrived.

abas.html:
comando 1 · alcancar direita (0.3, -0.2, 0.15) → executado: sim (mão a 1.1 cm do alvo)
comando 2 · girar_tronco 20° → executado: sim
comando 3 · alcancar esquerda (0.3, 0.25, 0.2) → executado: sim (mão a 1.0 cm do alvo)
comando 4 · voltar → executado: sim
robô de pé: sim · pelve a 0.79 m
executado: sim
saída: 0

Four commands, four executions, hand about 1 cm from each target, and the robot standing at the end.

comando 1 · alcancar direita (0.9, -0.2, 0.15) → recusado: alvo a 0.92 m do ombro; o braço alcança 0.38 m
comando 2 · girar_tronco 200° → recusado: fora do limite da cintura (-150° a 150°)
comando 3 · pular → recusado: ação desconhecida (conheço alcancar, girar_tronco, voltar)
robô de pé: sim · pelve a 0.79 m
executado: não · 3 comando(s) recusado(s)
saída: 1

Target 92 cm from the shoulder (the arm reaches 38 cm to the wrist), waist at 200° (the limit is 150°), and an action that doesn't exist: all three are refused before any movement, and the robot stays still and standing.

exercicios.texto: Run the bad commands file and read the reason for each refusal.
exercicios.pronto: python3 kit/comando_wbc.py --comandos kit/comandos-ruins.json | tail -1 → executado: não · 3 comando(s) recusado(s).

exercicios.texto: Write ~/fth/movimentos/meus-comandos.json with five commands (both hands, a torso turn, and return) and run it. If any is refused, the reason gives the distance to the shoulder: the arm reaches 0.38 m to the wrist.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: The VLA says to reach a point 92 cm from the shoulder. What should the lower layer do?
opcoes: Try anyway, stretching the arm to the limit of the joints.
Walk to the point on its own, without telling the upper layer.
Pass the command to the PD, which handles the reach by itself.
Refuse before moving, with the reason, and hand it back to the upper layer.
perguntas.explica: Checking before executing is what keeps a bad command from turning into motion. The VLA can be wrong; the low-level control is the last barrier before the joints.

perguntas.p: In decoupled WBC, who takes care of the legs?
opcoes: An RL policy that walks and balances.
The arm IK, extended all the way down to the feet.
Nobody: the legs stay locked during the task.
perguntas.explica: RL on the legs, IK on the arms. In the kit, the legs hold the model's pose through PD, in the place where the policy would go.

perguntas.p: What does the May 7, 2026 GR00T-WholeBodyControl flow put together?
opcoes: Isaac Lab 2.1.0 and BeyondMimic to train the VLA.
Teleop to collect data, N1.7 fine-tuning, and SONIC as the controller.
GMR and LAFAN1 to generate the VLA from animation.
A VLA that makes whole-body control unnecessary on the G1 and commands the joints directly.
perguntas.explica: Collection by teleop (lesson 5), VLA fine-tuning (course vla-v72), and SONIC underneath (lesson 4): the layers of this course, connected.

itens.texto: The VLA says the what; whole-body control decides the how.
The interface (targets, tokens) is what connects one to the other.
The lower layer refuses what can't be done, before moving.
